            status, job, _ = drain_job(ROOT, config, queue, job_id)

evidence.reason: The priority sort key calls `pending(job_id)` inside `sorted(...)` with no surrounding exception handling. The only per-item exception handler is later, around `process_item` (line 892), so an unreadable result that makes `pending()` raise aborts the entire drain before `drain_items` admits any healthy item. This is a real containment gap in existing behavior, not a new requirement.
